role: One post-open Case 19 frame-zero mechanism gate for the smallest normalized-coordinate 3D exact block-Jacobi preconditioner. It is physically different from the closed coordinate-line Schwarz, diagonal Jacobi, fixed global low-rank, fixed octant, Sobolev and global quadratic geometry-weight routes.
scientific_question: Does exact local cross-axis coupling inside fixed normalized-coordinate 3D voxel blocks repair the common Case 19 frame-zero interior-gradient blocker under the unchanged K16 PCGLS call budget, before any complete 429-cell warm-sequence run is authorized?
physical_hypothesis: The one cell left unresolved by the K14-to-K16 envelope is shared by every old arm at frame zero. A minimum 3D block spanning one normalized-space quarter-cell cube captures nearest-neighbour cross-axis normal couplings that diagonal Jacobi omits and coordinate-line Schwarz separates. If those couplings are the missing mechanism, zero-start block-PCGLS K16 should pass every frozen frame-zero field, gradient, interior-gradient and observation gate while same-cost diagonal-Jacobi and unpreconditioned controls remain incomplete.

frozen_data_and_geometry.camera_roster: For each frozen rig use the first nine stable IDs in the v209 order, then sort IDs in ascending ASCII order before operator construction.
frozen_data_and_geometry.camera_permutation_requirement: Reversing the labeled source roster and canonicalizing it must reproduce identical canonical IDs, observations, block partition, exact/loaded/inverse blocks, fields, residuals, calls and metrics within the frozen numeric bounds.
frozen_data_and_geometry.preprocessing: Reuse the exact v244.2 full-grid rectilinear verification, source-to-zyx axis map, float64 trilinear interpolation, one-voxel support and mean gauge; read and score only the already-opened snapshot id 0 density while still validating the full 37-object byte roster.
frozen_data_and_geometry.truth_use: CFD truth generates the frozen synthetic frame-zero observation and scores four veto metrics only. It does not enter block construction, preconditioning, depth, controls or stopping.

unique_preconditioner.name: exact_reported_geometry_normalized_cube_voxel_block_jacobi_4x2x2_loading_1e-6
unique_preconditioner.normal_operator: Use the exact reported-geometry straight-ray forward A and exact adjoint.
unique_preconditioner.normalized_coordinate_rationale: The forward grid spans [-1,1] on every axis. With shape 32x16x16, a 4x2x2 voxel tile has the same normalized coordinate side length 0.25 on z,y,x and is the smallest such tile containing cross-axis neighbours.
unique_preconditioner.partition: Tile the full 32x16x16 array from origin (0,0,0) with non-overlapping 4x2x2 blocks in z-major, then y, then x order. Retain only the frozen one-voxel-support interior cells inside each tile. Every active cell must appear exactly once; unsupported boundary cells are never inverted and remain zero.
unique_preconditioner.block_definition: For each retained active-cell block R_b, form B_b = R_b (A^T A) R_b^T by summing exact per-view, per-component operator row outer products.
unique_preconditioner.stabilization: Set Btilde_b = B_b + 1e-6*diag(diag(B_b)). No other ridge, floor, clip or scale is allowed. Every active diagonal must be strictly positive and every Btilde block must be finite positive definite or execution is invalid.
unique_preconditioner.inverse: Use float64 symmetric eigh on each Btilde block and form its exact spectral inverse; symmetrize once by averaging with its transpose.
unique_preconditioner.application: Restrict the current normal residual to each non-overlapping active block, multiply by that block inverse, and scatter once to the same active cells. Boundary output is exactly zero.
unique_preconditioner.tie_break: There is no data-dependent choice. Block traversal is fixed z-major/y/x; active indices are C-order; eigenvalues are ascending as returned by symmetric eigh.
unique_preconditioner.forbidden_search: No block size, origin shift, overlap, coloring, block merge, loading, floor, clip, scale, depth, initializer, regularizer, metric, threshold or candidate search is allowed after freeze.

solver_and_arms.recurrence: Standard fixed-SPD PCGLS for the primary and diagonal control, and unchanged CGLS for the unpreconditioned control. No fallback, stopping, line search, warm start or learned component is present.

accuracy_gate.control_dominance: If either same-cost control also passes every frame-zero cell, 3D block-specific headroom is not isolated.

formal_execution.formal_method: Validate the full sealed 37-object roster, independently preprocess only snapshot id 0 after the protocol is frozen, construct all thirteen canonical nine-camera operators and exact 3D blocks, run and physically replay all three arms, and seal fields, residuals, calls, block states and observations before truth scoring.
formal_validity_requires: finite frame-zero truth and exact boundary/gauge
512 blocks covering 5880 active cells exactly once per rig
18 exact view-component row blocks per rig
positive loaded block spectra and SPD probes
prediction tree unchanged during truth scoring

independent_validation.method: A second program must use the independent v244 grid parser, independent observation/operator wrapper and independent PCGLS/CGLS recurrences; reconstruct every local Gram with explicit per-block matrix products rather than the formal batched gather/einsum; invert each loaded block independently; seal its arrays before opening formal scientific arrays; then recompute all metrics, gates, controls and costs.
independent_validation.normalized_residual_definition: max_abs(r_formal-r_independent)/max(l2(observation),float64_tiny); this scale-aware comparison is frozen prospectively for v248 and does not reopen or rescore v247.

decision_order: Any source, parent, shape, finite, partition, loading, SPD, stationarity, permutation, call-ledger, physical-replay, output-exclusivity, seal or formal-independent mismatch gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_CASE19_GEOMETRY_VOXEL_BLOCK_JACOBI_FRAME_ZERO_V248.

If the unique 3D block-PCGLS K16 primary fails any of the 13 absolute frame-zero cell gates, conclude FAIL_CASE19_GEOMETRY_VOXEL_BLOCK_JACOBI_FRAME_ZERO_V248 and close this fixed block mechanism without a full 429-cell run.

If the primary passes all 13 cells but either same-cost control also passes all 13, conclude PASS_CASE19_FRAME_ZERO_REFERENCE_BUT_BLOCK_ADVANTAGE_NOT_ISOLATED_V248 and do not claim block-specific headroom.

Only if the primary passes all 13 cells, both controls fail at least one, every ledger and independent check passes may conclude POST_OPEN_CASE19_GEOMETRY_VOXEL_BLOCK_FRAME_ZERO_HEADROOM_V248 and authorize a separately frozen full 429-cell warm K14 mechanism gate.
failure_action: Close the exact fixed 4x2x2 normalized-coordinate voxel-block Jacobi mechanism without changing block size, origin, overlap, loading, scale, depth, initializer or thresholds. Do not use a larger predictor or GPU to rescue it.
